reviews.review:
Been playing since it first came out. It's lost almost all of it's players and the developers are focusing on nude skins. 

Might be a year or two before actual content comes to this game.

Still no good content. In fact the devs introduced and EVEN MORE RNG system for ancestor modules. I will never recomend this game and i regret 99% of the time i spent playing it. 

1/10 game.

I liked warframe, i liked destiny. I love this game! Don't care what other detractors say, this game is awesome. I've never lost track of time so much. I played 11 hrs straight yesterday. Literally. Great grind, great gameplay. The dialog is a little much, but you can skip those parts. 8/10.
would not recommend this, if you want some bunny girls and stuff with fps, just please, go play the Bayonetta series. Conclusion: waste of time, money lore.

Waited 5 months for hype to died down and game to be more polished. Played this game for month and the half and spend about 150 euros on overpriced skins. This game has more negatives than positives and i do not recommend playing this game.
Positives: Combat, Desecndant and weapon crystallization (I can fit all 5 simbols into one mod slot, encouraging experimentation and somewhat progression even though i don't use this symbol i might in the future), Descendant design, dog.
Negatives: Recent weapon core system(It's pointless stat padding system that should't exit, we already had weapon mods that did the same thing, that could easily be changed to fit the scenario), Upcoming arcane tuning(Again Pointless grinding and stat padding), Story(Boring and repetetive), overpriced skins, boring open world, no massive public events.

Overall opinion: I was enjoying game and the grind up until core system, knowing devs in general they wont remove this feature, sure they will make it easier to get but i just dont see it being a good system in gereral same goes with arcane tuning. Games starts slowly becoming excel spreadsheet simulator. The main thing why Warframe is successful is because of trading, the most traded thing in chat are mods and frame parts. Introduce more cool mods and more desecndant instead of this gumba balls.
